plan.execution: Use original version-specific entry/exit rules and project simulator. Close decisions, next observed open. No fees/slippage/leverage. Full current equity per trade, reinvested. Each annual run starts flat and closes at end; continuous full runs carry across years. Raw original Pine TP/SL labels are not orders.
plan.ranking: Return only, separately within ETH6, BTC8 and BTC6. No win-rate or drawdown gate. Cash and buy-hold shown separately.
plan.freeze: All 50 configurations fixed before BTC fetch/results. No BTC-specific adjustment. ETH history has already been seen; BTC transfer is retrospective cross-asset evidence, not proof against every form of overfitting.
plan.coverage: All 12 early strategy versions plus 36 later representatives and 2 benchmarks. 280 historical entries include parameter sweeps and repeated baselines, not 280 independent ideas. Omitted entries retained in inventory; no new exhaustive grid.
plan.reused: Only identical source/parameters/period/data/engine traces can replace a calculation; verify previous two-year trade traces where available.
plan.gaps: Project market service only; validate original timestamps and OHLC. Re-fetch reported gaps once; never manufacture candles. Hold state across remaining internal gaps; missing intragap path unknown.
